_doc: Guards with NO failure-path evidence anywhere, each named, dated and reasoned. Read scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py's docstring before adding one: TWO rules bound this file, and the second is what makes the first enforceable. (1) A guard whose blast_radius is 'accounting' or 'money-at-risk' may not be listed here at all. (2) A guard REACHABLE from run_guards.py may not be listed here whatever it declares -- because blast_radius is written by whoever writes the exemption, so rule 1 alone would be cheaper to lie to than to satisfy. Reachability is a fact about run_guards.py, not a field. An entry naming a guard that has since gained a failure path is flagged STALE and must be deleted, so this file cannot silently pre-approve a regression.
